title: Rebuild an account by replaying its commands

cases.says: append() applies each command to the live account and logs it; replay() rebuilds the same balance by applying the log in log order, even when timestamps are out of order.
replay() builds a new account from zero: the live account keeps its balance, and replaying twice gives the same answer.
A withdrawal larger than the balance throws IllegalStateException and does not appear in the log or in a replay.
eventsSince(200) returns the commands stamped after 200, not the one stamped exactly 200.
A list returned by events() keeps the commands it had, even after more are appended.
